newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen property market seen recovering slowly.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen property market seen recovering slowly.

text.p: The property market in Shenzhen, just across the Chinese border from Hong Kong, is slowly recovering after several years of depression, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.
The newspaper said real estate investment rose 27 percent year-on-year to 8.329 billion yuan in the first three quarters of this year.
In the period, 13.037 million sq metres of building space was under construction, up 11 percent over a year ago. That included 7.93 million sq metres of residential housing, up six percent, it said.
The newspaper said sales of completed commercial real estate in the first nine months increased 18 percent year-on-year. It did not give the value of the sales.
As of end-1995, completed commercial buildings in the city totalled 24.20 million sq metres, including 15.20 million sq metres of residential apartments, it said.
